consigna: Write a complaint about something that went wrong on a trip or at home, reporting what the people involved said to you.
requisitos: The main point in the first two sentences (week 41)
Three past perfects to explain what happened before (week 42)
Six phrasal verbs, no formal substitutes (week 43)
Four reported sentences with correct *say* and *tell* (week 46)
Fact, effect and request, with a date (week 47)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread your corrected texts from weeks 41 to 47, plus the three lines from Survival Week. Write down the correction that appeared most often.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences that each carry a past perfect, a phrasal verb and a reported clause.
*Fri (5 min).* Record 90 seconds telling the same story out loud.
autochequeo: Are all six present, or did one crowd out the others?
Did the phrasal verbs survive once I had to think about content?
Is the request still specific after all the reporting?
Did I repeat the error I identified on Monday?
Did I use what Survival Week showed me was missing?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of six skills at once: summarising, past perfect, phrasal verbs, conversation management, reported speech and complaining. (1) For each, say whether it is present and done well. (2) Say which one collapsed under the pressure. (3) Give me one sentence that carries three of them correctly. Correct nothing outside these six. ---
